senses.gloss: Vaṭa, a companion of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2536 (given to Skanda by Aṃśa).
Vāṭadhāna^1 (“the king of the Vāṭadhānas”). § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2699 (among the incarnations from the Krodhavaśa gaṇa).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 86.
Vāṭadhāna^2, the country of the Vāṭadhānas. § 555 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 19, 600 (among the countries which were overrun by the armies).

Vāṭadhāna, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 285 (Nakula): II, 32, 1190 (dvijān, in the west, vanquished by Nakula).--§ 294 (Dyūtap.): II, 49, 1749 (brāhmaṇāḥ, Nīl. and PCR. take vāṭadhānāḥ as an appellative).--§ 295 (do.): II, 51, 1826 (do., do.).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 354.--§ 580 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 56, 2405 (in the army of Duryodhana, C. has by error Vāraº).--§ 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 11, 398 (had formerly been vanquished by Kṛshṇa).-§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 73, 3650 (had been slain by Arjuna).
